premises.evidence_span: Malaria infects 500 million people around the world every single year

premises.text: Gold-standard microscopy diagnosis is slow and costs a family's daily earnings
premises.evidence_span: they take about one hour to prepare the sample, and it costs all of his family's majority earnings for that day

premises.text: Clinicians miss low-level infections, so untreated patients keep the transmission cycle going
